Well, there was this one time I was sifting through old vinyl – a real dive shop, you know? – and I found a copy of The Velvet Underground’s *Transformer* that was practically falling apart. The cover was ripped, the vinyl warped, but the way Lou Reed’s voice just… *felt*… it was incredible. Honestly, it’s a reminder that a lot of the best stuff isn’t about pristine perfection.
